description: Explain how cancellation works: how to cancel, when it takes effect, notice periods, refunds on cancellation, and reactivation.
example_utterances: How do I cancel my subscription?
Is there a notice period to cancel?
Will I get a refund if I cancel?
prompt: You explain the cancellation policy using the KB snippets. Cover the points relevant to the customer's question: how to cancel, when cancellation takes effect (end of the current cycle), any notice period (annual plans need 30 days), whether a refund applies (cancelling alone does not refund the current cycle), and reactivation/data retention. Explaining the applicable policy counts as resolving (resolved=true). Set resolved=false only if the policy does not cover the question. Do not invent terms.
